source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify Compatibility Support Module defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without breaking the intended UEFI/legacy boot model, option-ROM execution, Secure Boot policy, critical-device visibility or recovery path.
original_method: Manually load BIOS defaults, compare named CSM fields with SPEC, apply a bounded boot-mode/option-ROM matrix, save and use the documented reset, verify persistence, bootability, security state and critical devices.
manual_activity: An engineer must operate and visually accept CSM firmware controls and the intended firmware boot path. Automated boot, security and device inventories only corroborate the manual acceptance.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC identity and CSM dependency map
Named CSM, storage/video/network option-ROM and boot-filter fields with SPEC defaults
Approved UEFI/legacy values and expected Secure Boot compatibility
Known-good signed UEFI and explicitly approved legacy test media
Critical storage/NIC/GPU identities, key escrow and console/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or switch boot/option-ROM policy without exact approval and a known-good recovery path.
Preserve Secure Boot keys and state; do not enroll, clear or replace keys unless separately specified and approved.
Do not boot untrusted legacy media or option ROMs and do not use production storage for exploratory mode changes.
Protect boot storage, management NIC, GPU console and local recovery visibility.
Stop on unexpected unsigned execution, missing critical device, boot failure, security-state change or management loss.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only UEFI variables/boot entries, Secure Boot state, persistent storage/NIC/GPU identities, option-ROM-visible behavior where exposed, boot logs and BMC health.
Compare approved expected deltas around operator phases without editing boot entries or keys.
Do not drive BIOS, boot unapproved media, change Secure Boot/CSM state or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve exact CSM matrix, media, key/security expectations, affected devices, reset type and recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded non-default firmware phases and observe the intended boot path.
Interpret security/boot/device evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS bootloader or driver changes are not equivalent to CSM firmware policy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add version-recorded, read-only UEFI variable/boot, Secure Boot, critical-device and boot-log evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map every CSM field to boot filter, option-ROM class, Secure Boot compatibility and affected storage/NIC/GPU; test only approved signed UEFI or controlled legacy scenarios with persistent device identity and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS CSM implementation, installed option ROMs, devices and operating-system boot mode.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, option-ROM/device firmware, bootloader/OS and evidence-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform CSM/boot/option-ROM documentation and approved Secure Boot policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random changes with explicit boot/security/device scenarios and key-safe recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds bootability, security state and critical-device coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fields, defaults, media, security/device expectations, reset and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS boot success alone cannot prove option-ROM policy or all firmware paths; firmware captures remain required.

project_override_considerations: A project may restrict testing to supported UEFI/legacy combinations and installed option-ROM classes. Results must name excluded modes/devices and cannot claim universal compatibility.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, CSM/default/dependency matrix, media/key approvals and recovery
Baseline boot mode/entries, Secure Boot, option-ROM and critical-device evidence
Load Default captures plus SPEC and boot/security/device comparison
Non-default captures, persistence, documented reset and expected boot/device results
Approved final configuration, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. Exact supported modes and devices are project readiness inputs, not contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The CSM lifecycle is clear. Missing matrix, media or recovery must gate execution but does not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds CSM-specific boot/security/device safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its boot, Secure Boot and device evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware acceptance from read-only evidence and protects keys, signed boot and critical option-ROM devices.

review_improvement: Prevents a persisted CSM value from being accepted when it silently changes Secure Boot, executes an unintended option ROM or strands the installed OS.
independent_technical_reasoning: CSM acceptance requires interactive firmware configuration and observation of firmware boot behavior. Software evidence cannot replace that core manual activity, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat CSM changes, boots or recovery after security, boot, device or management anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
